headline_marked: Police find [[primary evidence of sexual abuse]] of 7-year-old girl in Tongi madrasah
headline: Police find primary evidence of sexual abuse of 7-year-old girl in Tongi madrasah
summary: A madrasah teacher has been arrested following the abuse of a first-grade student; the case has sparked conflicting claims of mob justice and theft.
details: Police in Gazipur's Tongi have found primary evidence of sexual abuse against a 7-year-old girl at a local madrasah. CCTV footage and other evidence were collected from the premises on Saturday.
The victim, a first-grade student, gave her statement to the Gazipur Metropolitan Magistrate Court. A 30-year-old teacher, Moslem Ahmed, has been arrested and is currently in jail.

The abuse reportedly occurred on October 19 on the ground floor stairs of the madrasah. The girl's family discovered the incident after she refused to attend school and eventually revealed the details to her parents.
Following the discovery, the girl's family confronted the teacher on October 21. This led to a gathering of local people, during which the teacher was reportedly beaten.

The madrasah's founder and principal, Almas Hossain, has filed a separate complaint alleging that a group of 15-16 people led by the girl's father beat other staff and looted 17 lakh BDT and five mobile phones.

The girl's father has denied the allegations of looting and mob violence, stating he only sought justice for his daughter. He has called for a fair investigation into both the abuse and the accusations against him.

Following the discovery, the girl's family confronted the teacher on October 21. This led to a gathering of local people, during which the teacher was reportedly beaten.

The madrasah's founder and principal, Almas Hossain, has filed a separate complaint alleging that a group of 15-16 people led by the girl's father beat other staff and looted 17 lakh BDT and five mobile phones.

The girl's father has denied the allegations of looting and mob violence, stating he only sought justice for his daughter. He has called for a fair investigation into both the abuse and the accusations against him.
